proposals: FBIL should publish daily reference rates for the rupee against the yuan, rouble and riyal, labelled as derived cross-rates if direct trading is too thin, so analysis of India's largest trade relationships does not depend on a commercial data feed and hand-built crosses, as this piece had to.

The RBI should publish the daily bilateral cross-rates it uses to compute NEER and REER for all 40 basket currencies as a downloadable series, so anyone can reproduce the official indices and the pair-by-pair moves underneath them.

The RBI should publish NEER and REER as one revision-tracked monthly series with a clearly stated latest value, so the moderation its bulletins describe can be cited as a single consistent figure rather than reconciled across separate prints.

The RBI should publish monthly trade settled through Special Rupee Vostro Accounts and the UAE Local Currency Settlement System, by partner country, so growth from figures like ₹14,000 crore in February 2026 can be tracked against the roughly ₹25 lakh crore these five relationships represent.
